LT_1P_ARCSLAYER.Description: Walk in the light of aetheric science. It's like normal light, but far more technologically advanced.

LT_1P_UNSEEN.Description: Designed by the Unseen cult. "What?s so funny?"

LT_1P_ESCALATION_UMBRAL.Description: The gaze of the Umbral Void has fallen upon you.

LT_1P_ESCALATION_TERRA.Description: There are dim lights, bright lights, and brilliant lights. But few are those who walk in the light of true genius.

LT_ARMSTRONG.Description: A Slayer's lantern for those who have entered the fiery domain of Torgadoro and lived to tell the tale.

LT_BASIC_01.Description: A lantern designed for technical work.

LT_BASIC_02.Description: A popular lantern design that's remained unchanged for decades.

LT_BASIC_03.Description: Bright, tall panels cast clear light on any situation.

LT_BASIC_04.Description: A lantern style often used by Orrery scholars.

LT_BASIC_05.Description: A lantern design that allows more focused lighting.

LT_BLACKCAT_00.Description: There's a reason they can see so well in the dark.

LT_EVENT_RADIANT_SOLSTICE.Description: Time to catch some rays, Slayer.

LT_EVENT_SPRING_00.Description: It's either a lantern in the shape of a pufflehop or a very disturbing piece of aetheric taxidermy. Best not to ask.

LT_FROSTFALL_MISTLETOE.Description: A cheerful lantern topped with fresh winter mistletoe.

LT_FROSTFALL_SNOWFLAKE.Description: A crystalline star that shines like ice.

LT_HP03_MOSSY_00.Description: Charged with the aetheric essence of the forest.

LT_HP04_ARID_00.Description: It burns as brightly as the sun.

LT_HP04_ARID_01.Description: Carved from the bones of a beast found only in the barbarian's domain.

LT_HP06_PIRATE_00.Description: A light that cuts through the darkness.

LT_HP06_PIRATE_01.Description: One if by land, two if by sky.

LT_HP06B_ACADEMY_00.Description: A searcher's lantern constructed for Zephyr Strike rescue ops.

LT_HP06B_ACADEMY_01.Description: A recon lantern designed for Zephyr Strike night missions.

LT_HP06B_ACADEMY_02.Description: An aggressive lantern designed for Zephyr Strike assault missions.

LT_HP08A_HEROES_00.Description: A potent icon of the First Slayer modeled after an extinct but legendary beast.

LT_HP08B_PUNK_00.Description: You can't handle this lantern! Because it's very sharp. Wear gloves.

LT_HP08B_PUNK_01.Description: Who knew light could weigh so much?

LT_HP09A_ASSASSINS_00.Description: Slices through the darkness like a raptor in flight.

LT_HP09A_ASSASSINS_02.Description: A Blaze Hawk never loses their sense of direction.

LT_HP09B_COMMANDO_00.DescriptionHold: Oh, you'd better believe it does more than just light up.
LT_HP09B_COMMANDO_00.Description: Oh, you'd better believe it does more than just light up.

LT_HP10B_RAIDERS_00.Description: You always were a clever whippersnapper.

LT_HP10B_RAIDERS_03.Description: Forge a path through the darkness with a lantern co-designed by Wils Bormen and Moyra Heigsketter to mark the grand opening of their joint venture, the new Ramsgate Smithy.

LT_HP11A_ALCHEMIST_00.Description: A lantern containing a tiny fragment of charged archonite shaped by alchemancy.

LT_HP12A_FROSTWARDEN_00.Description: A lantern that glows with the power of frost aether.

LT_HP11A_ALCHEMIST_02_R.Description: An alchemancer's lantern steeped in mysterious energy and renewed bravery.

LT_HP11A_ALCHEMIST_02_B.Description: An alchemancer's lantern steeped in mysterious energy and brilliant ideas.
